def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    # find the unique 3-shape
    cells=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=0 and v!=5 and v not in (0,)]
    # generic: shape color = any color not equal to background candidates; here 3

    # use the known structure: shape cells = positions of color c, holes = zeros inside bbox
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    c=[k for k in cnt if k not in (0,5)]
    c=c[0] if c else None
    th=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==c]
    mi=min(p[0] for p in th); mj=min(p[1] for p in th)
    h=max(p[0] for p in th)-mi+1; w=max(p[1] for p in th)-mj+1
    mask=[(i-mi,j-mj) for i,j in th]
    holes=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if (i,j) not in mask and g[mi+i][mj+j]==0]
    for oi in range(H-h+1):
        for oj in range(W-w+1):
            vals=[g[oi+a][oj+b] for a,b in mask]
            if all(v==c for v in vals):
